scripts.setup: npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix contracts test && npm --prefix web test && uv run --project runner --group test pytest runner/tests
scripts.contracts:check: npm --prefix contracts run check && uv run --project runner --group test pytest runner/tests
scripts.demo:play: npm run demo:queue:smoke && npm run demo:runner
